Every item on an order has a status. **Ren Order Status** defines them: how each one is shown, the button that leads to it, and what it means. The production centers use them in their [flows](/Docs/Production%20Centers)."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Fields","key":"md_fields","id":"fields","name":"md_fields","value":"# Fields

- **Status**: the name (Sent, Processing, Completed…).
- **Shown As**: how the status reads on screens, for example *Waiting*, *Preparing*, *Ready*.
- **Action**: the verb on the button that **leads to** this status. A station shows each ticket's current status and, on its button, the action of the next status: an item in *Sent* shows **Start** because *Processing*'s action is "Start".
- **Color** and **Icon**.
- **Waiter Can Edit**: items in this status still belong to the waiter: they can be changed or removed and go out with the next **Send**. Only the statuses before sending have it (Pending, Attending).
- **Marks**:
  - **Ready**: the kitchen is done with the item. Stations that wait for the whole order start from here.
  - **Finished**: it reached the guest (served or delivered).
- **Ask who delivers**: moving an order into this status asks for the driver (for example *On the way*)."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"The statuses Ren POS creates","key":"md_the_statuses_ren_pos_creates","id":"the-statuses-ren-pos-creates","name":"md_the_statuses_ren_pos_creates","value":"# The statuses Ren POS creates

| Status | Shown As | Action | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending | Pending | Add | new item, editable |
| Sent | Waiting | Send | at its production center |
| Processing | Processing | Start | being prepared |
| Completed | Completed | Complete | ready (Marks: Ready) |
| Delivering | Delivering | Pick up | on its way to the table |
| On the way | On the way | Dispatch | out for delivery (asks the driver) |
| Delivered | Delivered | Deliver | with the guest (Marks: Finished) |

Others (Invoiced, Cancelled, Returned…) are set by the system. Rename the **Shown As** and **Action** texts freely to match how your team talks; keep the names, which other records refer to."}}]}]
